promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-02 (nyiso-112). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-02-nyiso112-ramp-plus-peaker (bundle results/calibration/nyiso112_combined_D). Determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, C3c the sole ledgered caveat. ONE delta vs the nyiso-111 keeper promoted earlier the same session: nysdec_peaker_rule_availability=true. ZERO free parameters (ledger 28 -> 29 entries, n_residual unchanged at 6). THIS KEEPER CARRIES TWO NEW MECHANISMS OVER nyiso-109, EACH ATTRIBUTED SEPARATELY AGAINST THE SAME ZERO-DELTA CONTROL (nyiso111_control_A, which reproduces the committed nyiso-109 keeper at EXACTLY 0.0 MW on every class-hour in all three years): ramp_limits (nyiso-111 arm B) and the NYSDEC 227-3 overlay (nyiso-112 arm C). Both were pre-registered before they solved and both passed every construction and kill gate on their own; arm D confirms they compose without interaction. WHAT THE PEAKER DELTA IS: NYSDEC 6 NYCRR Subpart 227-3 caps ozone-season (May 1 - Sep 30) NOx from simple-cycle turbines in two phases (2023-05-01, 2025-05-01); units whose compliance plan is ozone-season shutdown are unavailable to the energy market inside the window. The curated schedule (data/raw/reference/nysdec-227-3-peaker-compliance.csv, 24 rows sourced row-by-row to NYISO Gold Book Tables IV-3..IV-6 with a per-unit citation on every row) zeroes those units inside their own windows. AVAILABILITY ONLY, never an offer or a price -- the same rule-13 [R-MEASURED] class as the CAMPD unit-outage windows, with a forward story (the schedule runs to the 2030 NYPA statutory phase-out). STAR-designated Gowanus/Narrows barges are carried in the file and deliberately NOT restricted. HOW IT WAS FOUND: it had NO ROW IN THE CROSS-ISO MECHANISM MATRIX AT ALL -- a rule 28(c) hygiene gap on a solve-affecting field that made its status invisible to every session since it was written. It was armed exactly ONCE (nyiso-46, 2026-07-04) as one of three stacked mechanisms in a probe that stayed a probe for unrelated reasons (C1-2024 ST_GAS), and which the calibration log calls that session's BEST, 'most structurally faithful' probe. There is NO rejection of the overlay anywhere in the record and every NYISO bundle since read false: it was dropped in a keeper-lineage change, not adjudicated out. RULE 19 [R-ONE-MECH] CHECKED BY MEASUREMENT, NOT ASSUMED: the CAMPD outage overlay does NOT already zero these units -- on the superseded keeper's own solved 2023 dispatch the restricted GTs run INSIDE their own windows (Coxsackie GT1 316.5 MWh / 42 h, Glenwood GT3 371.2 / 9 h, Northport GT 116.8 / 11 h, Shoreham 114.5 / 7 h, all after the 2023-05-01 effective date). GATES: K1 exactly one config delta. K3 liveness -- ozone-window dispatch at the restricted plants falls -796.2 / -549.1 / -1,888.5 MWh. K4 WINDOW FIDELITY IS EXACT: the out-of-window delta is 0.0 MWh in all three years, so the overlay fires only inside its own declared windows. K5 span [2023, 2024, 2025]; the holdout spend freeze is ACTIVE and untouched. No kill fires: C3a +7.572 / -0.591 / -9.563 % all in band with 2025 moving TOWARD band centre (from -9.657 %), C1/C7/C8 PASS, zero slack and zero dump in every zone-hour. THE HEADLINE, AND IT IS THE FIRST C3c MOVEMENT AT NYISO IN THE WHOLE EXHAUSTED-QUEUE ERA: C3c 2025 moves 7 -> 14 hours >$300 against a measured 42 (0.17x -> 0.33x). 2023 and 2024 are unchanged at 3 and 0. The caveat is NOT retired -- the model still under-produces the tail and C3c stays the one ledgered caveat -- but its worst year improves, and it improves for the mechanism's OWN dated reason: the 2025-05-01 second compliance phase (Astoria 1, Arthur Kill GT1, 59th Street GT1) removes downstate peaker availability in exactly the hours and zones where NYISO's measured RT tail occurs (nyiso-92 dated the tail as summer; nyiso-94 measured every model >$300 hour as Long Island). The restriction is dated by the regulation, never sized to the residual -- rule 13 [R-MEASURED], the admissibility test the C3c lever queue was closed under. RULE 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE]: 227-3 is New York State regulation with no analogue in any other ISO. PREREG-nyiso112-nysdec-peaker-rule-2026-08-02.md carries the binding no-tuning clause: the compliance file is a regulatory record and may not be edited, extended, re-scoped or partially applied in response to this result. Evidence: results/calibration/_nyiso112_decpeaker_ab.json (arm C gates), _nyiso112_combined_ab.json (arm D composition), sibling probe 2026-08-02-nyiso112-dec-peaker-rule. PRIOR KEEPER: 2026-08-02-nyiso111-ramp-envelopes, superseded not retracted -- its ramp-envelope mechanism is carried forward in this recipe.

frontier.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
